description: Ornith 1.0 35B A3B Q6_K by Ornith AI
gpu_tip: ~45GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus ~48GB of DDR5 system RAM handles it comfortably, with llama.cpp keeping as many layers on the GPU as VRAM allows.
mac_tip: Needs ~45GB — a 48GB MacBook Pro is close to its limit; a 64GB config (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) is safer.
